compatibility.reason: Official LLVM archive references a missing build-host static zstd library; use host shared zstd
compatibility.wrapper:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
out=$("$WASMBENCH_LLVM_CONFIG" "$@")
case " $* " in *" --system-libs "*) printf "%s\n" "$out" | sed "s@/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libzstd.a@-lzstd@g" ;; *) printf "%s\n" "$out" ;; esac
